articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, Sept. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA) (the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, will report its results for the third quarter of 2026 on Thursday, October 29, 2026 before the markets open. The Company will discuss its results in a conference call scheduled for 2:00 p.m. Central Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The telephone number for the conference call is 833-461-5787. The meeting ID for the conference call is 761930850. A recording of the call will be available until November 12, 2026, by dialing 833-309-1852. The meeting ID for the replay call is 761930850. West Bancorporation, Inc. is headquartered in West Des Moines, Iowa. Serving its customers since 1893, West Bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of West Bancorporation, Inc., is a community bank that focuses on lending, deposit services and trust services for consumers and small- to medium-sized businesses. The Bank has six offices in the greater Des Moines, Iowa
articles.title: West Bancorporation, Inc. to Announce Quarterly Results, Hold Conference Call
